column3: ## Checkbox is shown when returning to a saved draft

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Fill in the journal title, select Mexico in "Publisher's country" and leave the checkbox unchecked
Save the application as a draft
Go to your publisher dashboard and re-open the draft application

column4: The pre-assessment checklist checkbox is already shown, unchecked, without having to change the country

column3: Tick the checkbox, then save the application as a draft again
Re-open the draft from your publisher dashboard and go to page 2 (About)

column4: The checkbox is shown but is unchecked again. This is expected - the tick is not saved with the draft, so the applicant must confirm again before continuing.

column3: Click Next without ticking the checkbox

column4: You are not taken to page 3 and the checklist error message is shown
